summary: Fixed marketplace page issues and identified root cause of all page script errors. Main issues: (1) Missing renderAllProducts function in pages_marketplace.js causing marketplace to break, (2) DOM elements accessed at top-level script execution before DOM ready causing null reference errors across all pages, (3) Page-specific JS scripts loading without defer attribute. Fixed by: adding missing renderAllProducts function, moving DOM element queries inside initializePage() with null checks, and adding defer attribute to page-specific JS includes in head.php.
current_status: All marketplace issues resolved. DOM element access now properly guarded with null checks. Page scripts now load with defer attribute to ensure DOM is ready. Marketplace page should now work correctly with products rendering properly.
